title: Five rules for the indexing token

hotspots.label: Issued by Glean
hotspots.detail: The Indexing API supports only Glean-issued tokens. OAuth authentication is not available.

hotspots.label: Expiry and rotation
hotspots.detail: An expiration date is required. The minimum rotation period is 1440 minutes (24 hours). Automate rotation.

hotspots.label: Who can create it
hotspots.detail: Setup Admins, Admins, and Super Admins can create Indexing API tokens. Only Super Admins can grant global scope.

hotspots.label: Where it can be used
hotspots.detail: Restrict API access to known infrastructure with IP range restrictions.

hotspots.label: Shown once
hotspots.detail: The token is displayed only once after creation. Use separate tokens for dev, staging, and production.
